title: Wanting to return to Europe, Italy and Jerusalem
summary: She plans a longer European trip for its history and hopes to be in Jerusalem at Christmas.

blocks.x: You intend to go down to Italy, for instance? Oh, my God, yes, I must go there. Mm-hmm. And I think you said why don't you go to Palestine? Yeah, I want to go to Jerusalem.

It has always been my desire to be in Jerusalem for, uh, Christmas. You know, my Christmas song, Silent Night, which is a European song, sold so many thousand here in America and in Europe. And, um, it was my best song that I, that I sang, because I was there during the cold weather. I was there during October, November. Uh, I, I always wanted to be there since that beautiful song was written. And I understand it was, the song was written not very far from, uh, Bethlehem. Somebody was telling me the story about this song. I have so much to think about that I can't remember right now. But, um, somebody was saying that that, the, the composer didn't live very far from Bethlehem. And I would love to be in Jerusalem on Christmas Eve night. That I well understand.
